depth_corner_rigid_fit.method: median finite xyz in a 7x7 pixel patch around each of 54 color corners; rigid Kabsch fit to 6 mm checkerboard geometry

interpretation: A constant hand-eye translation offset cancels for constant tool orientation, so it cannot by itself explain this pose-dependent closure. Color PnP gives a 0.392 deg board-orientation change whereas raw-depth corner fitting gives 0.078 deg, near its within-group angular scatter; this suggests view-dependent color PnP orientation bias but is not an independent metrology verdict. Both color and depth show about 1.4-1.7 mm board-position closure error. Remaining possibilities include hand-eye rotation, camera intrinsics/depth scale or registration, robot physical kinematics, and mounting flex. Do not change factory DH from this test.
